name: What is the first step in remodeling a foreclosed home?

mainEntity.name: What is the first step in remodeling a foreclosed home?

acceptedAnswer.text: Remodeling a foreclosed property begins with securing the structure and completing an on-site evaluation to determine what is salvageable. The initial step focuses on testing mechanical systems, identifying hidden moisture or roof leaks, and checking structural framing. Next, the project requires trash-out and selective demolition to remove ruined drywall, compromised subflooring, or damaged fixtures. Once the property is cleared and safe, trade rough-ins for plumbing and electrical occur before rebuilding interior spaces with fresh framing, drywall, tile, and finish carpentry. Managing safety, hazardous debris, and utility activation first prevents costly rework during aesthetic finishes.
acceptedAnswer.description: The first step is securing the building, clearing debris, and evaluating framing, plumbing, and electrical systems before starting interior finishes.
